item.title: Red Dead Redemption Hits 3.3 Million Netflix Downloads on Mobile
item.description: Red Dead Redemption hits 3.3 million Netflix downloads on mobile, underscoring how subscription access drives reach over paid sales.

item.title: Nintendo President Discusses Nintendo Switch 2 Supply, Pricing, Games, and Media Plans
item.description: Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa shares updates on Nintendo Switch 2 supply, pricing, future games, and Nintendos plans beyond hardware.

item.title: The Sims 4 Adds The Coach Collection in Free Update
item.description: A free Sims 4 update adds The Coach Collection, introducing new Create a Sim outfits, accessories, and décor items.

item.title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot sales top 10 million; new DLC launches January 15
item.description: Total sales for CyberConnect2-developed action RPG Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot have surpassed 10 million units worldwide, and the downloadable content DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2 will launch on January 15, publisher Bandai Namco announced (2).

item.title: Early Access Hytale has Already Made Enough Money to Cover the Next 2 Years of Development Costs
item.description: Simon writes: "Pleased to announce that we have officially secured the next two years of development costs through pre-purchases. Combined with my personal commitment of ten years, we are looking very strong for the future Thank you all for the support. Hytale is saved. We are almost home."

item.title: High On Life 2 coming to Switch 2 on April 20
item.description: Squanch Games will release High On Life 2 for Switch 2 on April 20, the developer announced. The PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Microsoft Store) versions will still launch on February 13 as previously planned. It will also be available via Game Pass.

item.title: The murder mystery game, Clue: Murder by Death, is coming to PC, consoles, and mobile in Q1 2026
item.description: "Cocodrolo Games are today very happy to announce that their murder mystery game, Clue: Murder by Death, is coming to PC, consoles, and mobile in Q1 2026." - Cocodrolo Games.

item.title: New owner of GOG discusses taking on Steam, the devil of DRM, and following in Nightdive's footsteps
item.description: "We see DRM as something which can make the life of a legal customer more difficult," says Micha Kiciski, "so there is no reason to keep it alive."
